hard_conflicts.reason: Design lead: pick one, not both. The first one you ticked is kept; the other is skipped.
Writing: pick one, not both. Their banned-pattern lists collide if stacked in one edit. The first one you ticked is kept; the other is skipped.

soft_conflicts.reason: Both cover Remotion creation. Keeping both is fine: superpowers is the workflow layer, remotion-skills is the official reference.
soft_conflicts.resolution: Load only one writing filter per draft or use distinct sub-features.

soft_conflicts.reason: Anti-slop includes antislop-copywriting, which overlaps no-ai-slop's banned list. Load only one writing filter per draft, or use anti-slop's UI and code parts only.
soft_conflicts.resolution: Load only one writing filter per draft or use distinct sub-features.

soft_conflicts.reason: Anti-slop includes antislop-copywriting, which overlaps stop-slop's banned list. Load only one writing filter per draft, or use anti-slop's UI and code parts only.

soft_conflicts.reason: emilkowalski-skills bundles animate alongside 15 other skills. Selecting both in the same stack creates redundant prompt files.

soft_conflicts.reason: Both provide full-suite SEO audits and schema validation. seranking-seo-skills connects to SE Ranking MCP; claude-seo-kit runs locally via Python.
soft_conflicts.resolution: Choose seranking-seo-skills for live platform metrics or claude-seo-kit for keyless local audits.

soft_conflicts.reason: Both enforce ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English rules. Loading both creates redundant style prompt instructions.
soft_conflicts.resolution: Select docs-writing for pure manual guidance or ste-plain-writing for Python linter diagnostic enforcement.

soft_conflicts.reason: Both cover end-to-end B2B sales pipelines from prospecting to closing. Running both simultaneously creates overlapping workflow guidance.
soft_conflicts.resolution: Pick closer-skill for interactive call coaching or agentic-sales-skills for stage-by-stage Markdown prompts.

soft_conflicts.reason: Both provide comprehensive multi-category SEO audits. claude-seo is a 19-agent Claude Code plugin; claude-seo-kit runs a standalone lightweight Python audit engine.
soft_conflicts.resolution: Use claude-seo for native Claude Code agent teams or claude-seo-kit for lightweight headless Python CLI execution.

soft_conflicts.reason: Both cover YouTube SEO, thumbnail ideation, and competitor strategy. claude-youtube has 14 sub-skills; youtube-seo-skills has 8 focused modular guides.
soft_conflicts.resolution: Select claude-youtube for comprehensive channel operations or youtube-seo-skills for lightweight standalone prompt modules.

soft_conflicts.reason: Both provide in-depth multi-category SEO audits. seo-intelligence-skill has 95 checks across 11 modules with read-only verification; claude-seo runs a 19-agent Claude Code plugin.
soft_conflicts.resolution: Choose seo-intelligence-skill for strict evidence-based audits or claude-seo for interactive multi-agent remediation.
